result.topic_en: Notation and weight formulas for right ascension and declination determined from ring-micrometer (circle micrometer) observations of several comparison stars.
result.transcription:
Kreismikrometerbeobachtungen
Rectascensionen $\alpha, \alpha', \alpha'', A$
Declinationen $\delta, \delta', \delta'', D$
Mittel der Zeiten $\tau, \tau', \tau'', T$
Mora $\mu, \mu', \mu'', M$
Durchmesser des Gesichtsfeldes in Zeit $= \frac{2}{15}\varrho = \sigma$
$\frac{\mu\cos\delta}{\varrho} = \sin\lambda,\ \frac{\mu'\cos\delta'}{\varrho} = \sin\lambda',\ \frac{\mu''\cos\delta''}{\varrho} = \sin\lambda'',\ \frac{M\cos D}{\varrho} = \sin L$
Dann ist
das Gewicht der Rectascension aus dem ersten Stern
$\frac{2\cos\lambda^2\cos L^2}{\cos L^2 + \cos\lambda^2 + \cos\lambda'^2 + \cos\lambda''^2}$
das Gewicht der Declination aus dem ersten Stern
$\frac{2\sin\lambda^2\sin L^2}{\sin L^2 + \sin\lambda^2 + \sin\lambda'^2 + \sin\lambda''^2}$

methods.what: Definition of field-of-view diameter in time units for the ring micrometer

items.english: Then the weight of the right ascension from the first star is [the formula given]; likewise the weight of the declination from the first star.
